verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a physical processor that the buyer owns and runs on their own machine, so 'self-hosting the core product' is a category error for this kind of product. Evidence about running LLMs and ML frameworks locally on the chip is about hosting other software, not about self-hosting the M4 Max itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
